notes: Initial intro 2026-02-24: product + infra; background: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics), heavy search/recos use.
They currently use a mix of pgvector (staging) and a small Pinecone paid account for prototypes.
Primary ask: embedding generation + cheap, reliable semantic search. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (fast onboarding) then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.

POC goals (agreed): 1) ingests 1.5M docs nightly (batch window 4-6 hours), 2) support 200 qps semantic-search steady-state, 3) 95th pctl NN latency < 150ms for 1536-d embeddings, 4) vector DB connector (pgvector/Weaviate) validated.
Throughput needs: bulk ingest ~60k vectors/hour (target) during nightly ETL; daytime query load ~150–250 qps with occasional spikes to 400 qps for campaign runs.
Model preference: open models with 1536-d embeddings (they evaluate Mistral-emb and open-768->1536 pipeline), willingness to test quantized variants if accuracy preserved.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit cost drops >30% vs hosted and latency/availability SLAs are met.
Security notes: must support SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs for embedding generation and query logs for 90 days, and KMS integration for keys. Data residency: US commercial region required.
Quote from VP Product on demo call: "We need predictable inference costs for our analytics tier — surprises kill margins."
SE feedback: tight KV cache behavior needed for repeated session queries; recommend Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and prefix caching in POC.
Requested artifacts sent: pricing deck, Dedicated SKU sheet, SOC2 report stub. Waiting on DPA redline from legal.
Recent ask: specific Dedicated sizing for 200 qps with 1536-d embeddings + burst plan to 400 qps; requested baseline benchmark numbers (p50/p95 token latencies and bulk ingest throughput).
